source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Default setting is [Disabled]
1. Boot into BIOS setup menu and enable Network Stack. Then save and exit
2. Check network boot device under BIOS
3. Boot into BIOS setup menu and disable Network Stack. Then save and exit
4. Check network boot device under BIOS

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Network Stack: change the BIOS Advanced Network-Stack setting from Disabled to Enabled and verify the function enables. A BIOS setup-menu write the agent cannot drive.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator enables Network Stack in BIOS and confirms the function enables successfully; agent cannot enter BIOS setup.

original_test_intent: Verify the default Disabled BIOS Network Stack state, successful Enabled persistence and expected network-boot device appearance, then Disabled restoration and corresponding BIOS boot-device state.
original_method: Record baseline, have an engineer enable/save/exit, re-enter BIOS and capture the setting plus network boot device, then disable/save/exit, recapture the boot-device state, restore baseline and verify recovery.
manual_activity: The acceptance sequence consists of changing, saving and visually checking BIOS settings/device lists in both states; a human must perform and observe that core.
required_inputs: Expected network boot device/name per state
Approved access to the preserved project script
safety_requirements: One approval may cover the complete unchanged two-state plan.
Drain workloads and keep OOB recovery.
Do not alter boot order beyond the Network Stack setting.
Stop on unexpected device enumeration, failed boot or lost management.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare baseline/device comparison and collect supplied logs/screens.
Inspect the existing project script if made available; do not invent or replace it.
Report state differences without driving the BIOS UI or issuing PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Perform and capture both BIOS state transitions and boot-device lists.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Directionally correct but incomplete because it covers only enable, not default/disable or device lists.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Prefer the preserved project script only after its exact behavior/version is supplied and confirmed; it cannot replace required BIOS UI observations.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Default Disabled, enable/disable, network-device checks, script URL and 45/90-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture setting and boot-device list together after each save/reboot, diff identities/order without changing selection, and tie evidence to the existing approved script version if used.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC/NIC firmware and project-script revision.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner-supplied network-boot device specification and existing project script.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic per-state evidence and script traceability.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; weak Criteria does not remove Procedure's disable/device-list pass.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Device enumeration and boot order are distinct; this case checks presence/state, not PXE boot success.

project_override_considerations: A project supplies the expected NIC/device name and may use its approved script; execution must report exact scope and cannot omit the source-required disabled restoration pass.
expected_evidence: Enabled setting persistence and network boot-device capture
OOB/boot/log recovery, baseline restoration and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure clearly defines both states and device checks. Criteria is incomplete but does not contradict them; Procedure coverage remains authoritative.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Intent is clear; device expectation, operator, recovery and optional script access are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains operator boundary but corrects its missing half of the workflow.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on MANUAL ONLY and two-state coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Preserves the existing script preference while preventing it from substituting for BIOS UI acceptance and separates verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents an enable-only check from passing a source procedure that also requires disabled-state restoration and device-list inspection.
independent_technical_reasoning: Every decisive observation and setting change is inside BIOS Setup. Supporting log/script analysis can be automated, but the core remains human UI execution and therefore MANUAL ONLY.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat save/reboot or change boot devices automatically after an unexpected state; preserve UI/OOB evidence and stop.
